key_insight: PAPERBENCHX reveals a substantial gap between AI agents understanding scientific papers and producing independently reproducible evidence across disciplines.
engineering_relevance: Reliable AI-assisted materials research requires agents that can operate specialized software, make sound physical and numerical choices, and diagnose failed computations.
method: Benchmark agents on 93 expert-constructed paper-reproduction tasks spanning 12 research areas.
Provide source papers, public task specifications, and domain-native scientific environments.
Replay submitted workflows from scratch and score regenerated evidence against expert-validated criteria.
evidence_signal: Across 10 frontier agent configurations, the best fully reproduced only 14% of tasks at a 90% scoring threshold, while mean rubric scores ranged from 27.53% to 59.08%.
watch_item: Partial rubric success should not be treated as validated reproduction of a scientific claim.
paper_title: PAPERBENCHX: Can AI Reproduce Science Across Disciplines?
